selectionCriteria.gr8-original: A game built and published by GR8 GAMZ whose registry source is GR8 Originals.
selectionCriteria.editors-pick: A manually reviewed, playable starting point chosen to represent a distinct style within the category. This is not a player rating or popularity claim.
selectionCriteria.quick-play: The game record describes a short run, simple loop or immediate retry format.
selectionCriteria.mobile-friendly: The game record explicitly supports touch, phone or mobile play; individual provider controls can still vary.
selectionCriteria.keyboard-friendly: The game record explicitly names keyboard, arrow-key or WASD controls.
selectionCriteria.longer-session: The game record explicitly describes extended progression, campaign play or a longer session.
selectionCriteria.recently-added: The canonical registry has a valid addition date within 90 days of the category review.
selectionCriteria.popular-on-gr8: Requires category-level GR8 GAMZ analytics. This label is not shown when that evidence is unavailable.

categories.name: Action
categories.title: Free Action Games Online - Fast Browser Challenges
categories.description: Browse action games built around reactions, movement, survival and fast retries, with clear starting points for touch, mouse and keyboard play.
categories.h1: Free action games for fast reactions and bold moves
categories.introduction: Action games ask you to react while the situation is changing. The catalogue ranges from short survival runs and physics stunts to battle arenas and movement-heavy challenges, so the right starting point depends on how much control and pressure you want.
categories.distinction: What separates action from a general arcade game is sustained pressure: movement, timing or targeting keeps influencing the next decision instead of ending after one isolated move.

subgenres.name: Survival and dodging
subgenres.description: Stay in motion, read hazards and recover quickly after a failed run.

subgenres.name: Battles and brawlers
subgenres.description: Manage positioning, attacks and incoming pressure in direct confrontations.

subgenres.name: Physics and stunt action
subgenres.description: Use momentum, impacts and unusual movement as part of the challenge.

subgenres.name: Running and platform action
subgenres.description: Time jumps, lane changes or short movement sequences under pressure.

choosing: Choose a touch-led run when you want a short session with immediate retries.
Choose keyboard or mouse controls when precise movement or targeting matters more than portability.
Check the game profile before loading an external title because control detail and device fit vary by game.
categories.deviceGuidance: Tap and swipe action can work well on phones, while games with several movement or aim controls are usually easier on a keyboard, mouse or landscape screen.
categories.controlsGuidance: Look for one-input survival games for the simplest start. Pick explicit keyboard, WASD or mouse controls when you want finer movement and targeting.
categories.sessionGuidance: Short survival and stunt loops suit a quick break. Battle and exploration-led action can take longer because each attempt has more decisions.

editorialPicks.rationale: A focused hold-to-fly survival loop that demonstrates the category without a complex control setup.
A physics-led option for players who want action built around aiming, triggering and stunt outcomes.

categories.name: Adventure
categories.title: Free Adventure Games Online - Explore and Progress
categories.description: Find browser adventure games centred on exploration, discovery, choices and progress, from quick quests to broader simulation-style journeys.
categories.h1: Free adventure games built around discovery
categories.introduction: Adventure games give the next place, choice or objective as much importance as the immediate action. Some are compact quests with a clear decision loop; others use driving, exploration or simulation systems to create a longer-feeling journey.
categories.distinction: The category is defined by progression through places, objectives or discoveries. Reflexes can matter, but they support a sense of moving through an experience rather than chasing one isolated score.

subgenres.name: Quest and choice games
subgenres.description: Advance by choosing routes, solving local problems or taking measured risks.

subgenres.name: Exploration adventures
subgenres.description: Move through new areas and learn what the game expects as you progress.

subgenres.name: Driving and vehicle journeys
subgenres.description: Use travel, routes and changing environments as the core of the session.

subgenres.name: Idle and progression play
subgenres.description: Build resources or unlock progress through a slower, repeatable loop.

choosing: Start with a compact quest when you want a clear goal without a long setup.
Choose exploration or simulation when you have time to learn more controls and systems.
Use the profile's device notes before committing to a vehicle or 3D game on a small screen.
categories.deviceGuidance: Choice-led and touch-led adventures can travel well. Vehicle, 3D movement and multi-control games are generally clearer on tablets, landscape phones or desktop.
categories.controlsGuidance: Simple choices and taps reduce the learning curve. Directional movement, camera control or vehicle input gives more freedom but asks more from the device.
categories.sessionGuidance: A door choice or compact quest can fit a short break; exploration, driving and progression systems usually reward a longer visit.

editorialPicks.rationale: A concise risk-choice adventure that reaches its main decision loop quickly.
A vehicle-led journey for players who prefer a larger environment and a more involved control setup.
A contrasting adventure pick for players who want direct movement and discovery rather than idle progression.

categories.name: Multiplayer

categories.description: Browse multiplayer browser games with arena movement, competitive rounds and quick rematches, plus guidance on controls and session fit.
categories.h1: Free multiplayer games for competitive browser sessions
categories.introduction: Multiplayer games are organised around other participants, shared arenas or competitive round structures. They can feel immediate, but each game handles matchmaking, opponents and online availability differently, so read the profile and in-game prompts before assuming a specific mode.
categories.distinction: Unlike a solo score chase, multiplayer play depends on a shared or competitive game structure. GR8 GAMZ does not claim that every listed session always contains live human opponents.

categories.name: Puzzle
categories.title: Free Puzzle Games Online - Logic, Blocks & Brain Teasers
categories.description: Choose from logic, block, matching, sorting and spatial puzzle games, with practical guidance for quick touch play or deeper keyboard challenges.
categories.h1: Free puzzle games for logic, patterns and careful moves
categories.introduction: Puzzle games reward understanding a rule and applying it carefully. The catalogue includes quick matching and sorting loops, spatial movement problems, memory challenges and board-filling games, so difficulty depends as much on the rule set as the controls.
categories.distinction: Progress comes primarily from recognising patterns, planning moves or testing a solution. Speed can add pressure, but the central challenge is deciding what to do next.

subgenres.name: Block and spatial puzzles
subgenres.description: Rotate, move or place shapes while managing limited space.

subgenres.name: Matching and sorting
subgenres.description: Group colours, objects or symbols under a clear set of rules.

subgenres.name: Logic and route puzzles
subgenres.description: Plan a sequence of moves to reach a target or unlock a path.

subgenres.name: Memory and observation
subgenres.description: Recall positions or notice visual differences rather than relying on speed alone.

choosing: Pick matching or sorting for a short touch-friendly session.
Pick spatial movement or route planning when you want a problem that may take several attempts.
Check for explicit keyboard controls before opening a movement puzzle on a phone.
categories.deviceGuidance: Tap, drag and matching puzzles are often comfortable on phones. Spatial movement puzzles with WASD or arrow keys are better suited to a physical keyboard.
categories.controlsGuidance: The simplest puzzle controls are tap and drag. Keyboard-driven block movement offers precise input but should be chosen with the device in mind.
categories.sessionGuidance: Matching and memory rounds can be brief. Logic chains and difficult spatial puzzles may need a longer focused session.

categories.distinction: Movement is judged against a route, obstacle sequence, clock or rival. Even crash-focused games remain racing-led when steering and forward progress drive the main challenge.

categories.controlsGuidance: Tap-to-jump and hold-to-steer games start quickly. Keyboard and multi-button driving provides more precision but needs more space and practice.
categories.sessionGuidance: A stunt run or chase can fit a few minutes. Lap improvement and broader driving simulations encourage repeat attempts or longer play.

categories.distinction: Aiming or projectile management is the central action. Dodging and positioning still matter, but they support the decision about when and where to fire.

subgenres.description: Move through hazards while automatic or direct fire deals with incoming targets.

subgenres.name: Target and survival play

subgenres.name: Tactical shooting

categories.sessionGuidance: Arcade survival runs are designed for quick retries. Tactical or defence-led shooting usually asks for more planning and a longer session.
